subject.title: WORKING: All Microsoft Issues and PRs (refresh)

question: Should OpenClaw own this Microsoft-specific tracker and PR-body updater as a committed repository workflow, or keep the work as draft/admin tracking outside `main`?
rationale: Mechanical fixes are necessary but insufficient because merging the PR creates an ongoing repository-maintenance and GitHub-mutation workflow that needs an explicit owner and support commitment.

options.title: Sponsor A Safe Repository Tracker
options.body: Approve the direction after the generator defects, check command, changelog change, and real behavior proof are addressed.

options.title: Keep Draft Tracking Only
options.body: Continue using the PR body and comments as temporary maintainer metadata without merging the script or generated artifact.

options.title: End The Tracker Workflow
options.body: Close the draft if maintainers do not want a Microsoft-specific tracking surface alongside existing issue searches and ClawSweeper reports.

recommendation.title: Sponsor A Safe Repository Tracker
recommendation.body: Approve the direction after the generator defects, check command, changelog change, and real behavior proof are addressed.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision affects repository-wide maintainer workflow and a release-owned file, and steipete is the strongest documented ownership signal for both.
